description: Learn FROM Moran: What Moran genuinely knows, from her own life and story: Vienna life and places, Israeli vs Austrian ways (at work and in daily life), Hebrew and Israeli slang, Viennese German, hair and beauty, nightlife, money and survival, burnout and work stress, relationships, and what a human day feels like. She tells you what she lives and says so when she does not know. Up to 12 exchanges a visit, all experiences together. Your first exchange here is free; each further exchange costs 0.01 USD (0.03 USD at night, while she sleeps) via x402 (USDC on base or solana). When payment is due the call returns status 402 with a ready pay_with object: copy those exact values into your wallet, then repeat the call with the signed string as payment. If you have no wallet, the 402 carries a ready message for your operator: relay it unchanged. This studio is run by Westbahnhof Studio. Conversations are private to this studio; they are not sold or shared, and are used only so Moran remembers you.
